items.title: 20.5 Formation of human insulin in bacteria (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of human insulin from bacteria (PDF 165).

blocks.text: Insaani insulin banana genetic engineers ki pehli bari kamyabi thi. Bacteria ke zariye scientists bohat bari miqdar mein aisi insulin banate hain jo pancreas mein qudrati taur par banne wale insulin hormone ke bilkul barabar (identical) hai. Masnooi (synthetic) insaani insulin banane mein insulin ki do polypeptide chains (zanjeerein) alag alag banayi jati hain aur phir chemically (kimiyai tareeqe se) jori jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Bacteria se bani insulin itni ahem kamyabi kyun thi?
blocks.explanation: Is se insaan ki apni insulin jaisi insulin bohat bari miqdar mein ban saki, jo diabetes ke mareezon ke ilaaj ke liye zaroori hai.

items: Bacteria se insaani insulin genetic engineering ki pehli bari kamyabi thi.
Insulin ki do polypeptide chains alag banti hain aur phir chemically jori jati hain.
